title: Most children run by about 2 years
summary: Most children run by about 2 years, the US CDC says.
body: Runs is a movement line on the CDC 2-year page, listed with what most children do by 2 years. The page prints that single word for the skill. It does not describe speed or distance. Kicking a ball is a different line on the same page and is not this claim. The age comes from the US CDC list. It is not a fitness grade, and other countries' lists can differ.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Years
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Runs. Kicking a ball is a separate line and is not used here.
